description: Eight AI-simulated customer perspectives read one homepage and report evidence-backed problems that would stop people buying: unclear prices, missing contact details, unexplained policies, weak proof. Each finding has a category, severity, the personas affected, evidence (a word-for-word quote checked against the page, or what is missing), why it matters and a suggested fix. No score. Pass previous_reaction_id to verify fixes: an unchanged page returns the earlier findings without using the free check. 1 free check a day; after that the paid API costs $0.05 via x402. Simulated perspectives, not real customers.

previous_reaction_id.description: Optional: the reaction_id from an earlier check of the same site, to verify fixes. Kept for 30 days.

url.description: Full http or https address of the homepage, for example https://www.example.co.uk/

name: customer_reaction
title: Customer reaction check
